evidence: The repository README states it ships pretrained base weights (midi_rwkv.pth) and that the pretraining dataset is GigaMIDI.
Hugging Face dataset metadata for Metacreation/GigaMIDI reports license cc-by-nc-4.0 and gated: auto.
GitHub licence metadata for music-x-lab/POP909-Dataset (the finetuning set) reports MIT, so the finetuning data is not the blocker.
Full audit with confirmed and refuted claims: services/midi-rwkv-worker/release-evidence/license-review.json.
reason: The master plan required a weight and lineage audit before any COMMERCIAL_READY claim for this MIT-licensed project. The audit finds the shipped base weights are a derivative of CC-BY-NC-4.0 training data. A permissive code licence does not remove the NC term, so the claim cannot be made and commercial routing fails closed.
blockers: Base weights inherit CC-BY-NC-4.0 from GigaMIDI; no commercial-corpus retrain evidence is retained.
No isolated research runtime build is authorised by the retained review, so nothing has been downloaded, built, provisioned or run.
notRoutableBecauseNote: This is a rights block, unlike MAGENTA_RT2's quality-evidence shadow gate. The two are recorded differently on purpose.
pathToCommercialUse: Pretrain from scratch on a corpus whose licence permits commercial derivatives, retain the corpus licence and training provenance, set model.commercialCorpusRetrainEvidenceRetained to true in the review, and re-audit.
